Presentation.Title: Immigration and mobility in French-speaking Switzerland
Presentation.Subtitle: Clear steps, reliable follow-up
Intro: We help entrepreneurs, executives and families secure their move to Switzerland with a pragmatic, compliant approach.
We clarify the options (L/B/C permits, ANobAG, company incorporation) and coordinate with cantonal authorities and social insurance funds.
We handle the key steps so you keep a clear view of timelines, documents and costs.
Services: Status review and mobility strategy (EU/EFTA or third-country)
Coordination of residence and work permits (L, B, C, G)
ANobAG files and social insurance registration
Company incorporation and employment contracts when needed
Tax and payroll follow-up to stay compliant
